implementation: ImageLifetime weakly observes immutable pixel storage without retaining pixels; value clones and frozen snapshots share its lifetime.
Renderer cache maintenance retires expired unpinned image textures even below its reuse budget. Canvases keep active GPU resources pinned; stream uploads refresh the observed frame lifetime.
Domain ports, adapters, decoding, wallpaper selection, design tokens, image density and motion durations are unchanged. Cleanup adds no idle polling.

native_pixels.scope: Native compositor captures of temporary red/blue fixtures verify intermediate blends and outgoing-image retirement in both directions. Instrumented captures are not a smoothness benchmark.

assessment.cpu_scope: The video sample increased from 80.008% to 86.074% of one logical core. This change establishes lower retained texture payload and a lower observed RSS sample, not a CPU/pacing improvement.

procedure: Use the recorded build on one 1920x1080 output at scale 1, with profiling disabled and the five existing widgets visible.
Sample the settled static desktop after a service restart.
Import a copy of the 1280x800 H.264 landscape loop, set 15 FPS with native controls, close the panel and warm playback for five seconds before the second sample.
Verify the decoder remains active and background submissions advance through the sample; restore exact settings, wallpaper, exports and idle policy.

remaining: Video still exceeds 300 MiB RSS; static idle CPU is slightly above 1% in this sample.
Repeated hardware measurements, decoder/allocator/driver attribution, GPU allocations and physical-GPU pacing/power remain open.
Simultaneous native multi-output/suspend/reconnect and broader secure-session recovery acceptance remain open.
Final evidence-head CI and authorized merge.
privacy: No personal wallpaper pixels, source paths or credentials are included.
